title: v1.0.92 — Enhanced PDF Reports, Attendance & Stability Update
description: AcademicPulse v1.0.92 introduces beautifully enhanced Day, Weekly, and Monthly PDF reports with full session logs, improved Attendance calendar navigation, and performance fixes.
features:
📄 Enhanced PDF Reports
Weekly and Monthly PDFs now match the Day PDF with comprehensive study type & platform breakdowns (Revision, Class, YouTube, Instill) and detailed session logs.

🗓️ Attendance Calendar & Month Navigation
Smooth navigation across previous months with active day selection and monthly study hour summaries.

🔍 Day ID Search
Every report includes a unique Day ID (e.g. DAY-20261026). Search any Day ID to instantly open that day's overview dashboard.

📅 Upcoming Mock Exams Tracker
Easily schedule upcoming mock tests, track countdowns, and link them directly to your study plan.

⚡ Bug Fixes & Stability
Resolved date-parsing edge cases for legacy sessions, eliminated stale beta caches, and optimized rendering responsiveness.
